mediaAlternatives.title: President-Elect Of France Poses
mediaAlternatives.evidence: FALLBACK newsreel (no radio found). oEmbed 200, author 'British Movietone' (AP Archive official channel); description: '(18 May 1931) M Doumer, who secured nomination in competition with M Briand, makes his screen debut.' Shows the president-elect days after the vote; short English item, not a French announcement of the result.

mediaAlternatives.title: France's New President - Sound Version (1931)
mediaAlternatives.evidence: oEmbed 200, title "France's New President - Sound Version (1931)", author_name "British Pathé". Description: 'Paris. France's new President, Monsieur Paul Doumer, takes over official duties of the Republic.' Doumer reads a speech, drives with Laval; i.e. the June 1931 installation. 1:14, with sound. nocookie embed loaded in a cross-origin iframe (with a referrer) on 2026-11-07: player shown, no error; watch page playableInEmbed=true, playabilityStatus OK.
